lower of actual leave encashment and exemption limit

proposal_tds_estimate.value: For a pending hike or bonus proposal, TDS impact is estimated as if the amount is paid in the next open payroll month. Record that month in the result and add the flag "Estimated TDS if approved and paid in [month] payroll". The estimate is recalculated if the actual payment month differs.
